accepted.sentence: In ocean trenches, crewed research craft can descend beyond sunlight to document geological features under crushing ambient pressure.
During fleet exercises, crews rehearse coordinating with surface ships through brief radio transmissions when antennas reach the air.
On long patrols, compact living quarters require careful scheduling for meals, sleep, exercise, and hygiene among a confined crew.
After an onboard casualty, nearby naval forces may deploy a rescue vehicle to reach survivors trapped at great depth.
For coastal mapping, research teams chart channels and sediment patterns in shallow water that larger survey ships cannot safely enter.
In wartime mine-laying missions, crews may place explosives along an enemy harbor approach before withdrawing undetected.
At underwater volcanoes, scientists use crewed craft to inspect fresh lava formations and collect rock samples beyond ordinary diving limits.
In warm seas, crews face greater cooling demands because machinery and people release heat into sealed living spaces.
